===== FILE 20789__1.pdf =====
Dear Secretary Collins,  
 
As people concerned with the reproductive well-being of our veterans, we urge you 
to rescind the proposed rule published in the Federal Register on August 4, 2025, 
banning abortion counseling and care even in cases of rape, incest or health 
endangerment, for veterans and their loved ones. If implemented, this ban would 
have disastrous consequences for veterans and their beneficiaries.   
 
The VA’s promise to “promote, preserve, or restore” the health of their patients is 
directly at odds with this proposed rule – prohibiting counseling and abortion care 
even in cases of rape or incest is not promoting or preserving the health of anyone. 
This rule will only ensure that veterans and their beneficiaries cannot count on the 
VHA to support them and their health even in the worst of circumstances.   
 
Our veterans fought and sacrificed for our freedoms, and they deserve to be 
protected by an administration that supports theirs. Access to abortion care is a 
fundamental right and is essential to the health and well-being of veterans and 
their beneficiaries.   
 
This proposed rule is dangerous and harmful to veterans and their loved ones. With 
deep concern for the reproductive well-being of our veterans, we strongly urge you 
to consider the impact that this will have on the community you serve, and to 
rescind this proposed rule. 
 
On behalf of the below 645 advocates: 
  
Kate Lannamann - Osprey, FL 
Rosemary Knopff - Saint Paul, MN
